about: What the pinned awsiotsdk wheel declares: the Name, Version, Requires-Python and every Requires-Dist header of its METADATA, bound to that one file by its sha256 (a py3-none-any wheel, the same file in both connector locks). SDV Phase 4 WP0. The locks are installed with pip --no-deps, which would not notice an awscrt this wheel does not declare, so tests/test_sdv_connector.py holds each lock's awscrt to requires_dist, and sdv/connector/lockcheck.py compares this record with the wheel itself when one has been downloaded. A new SDK pin means a new record, read from the new wheel.
name: awsiotsdk
